responsibility: Implements string/enumeration conversion for Rust frontend ABI names. It belongs to the frontend’s call-convention handling utilities and translates parsed ABI spellings such as "rust", "C", "stdcall", or "rust-intrinsic" into the internal Rust::ABI enum and back, providing the canonical mapping consumed by parsing, semantic checks, and later code generation decisions.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable string-to-enum and enum-to-string ABI conversion logic; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-abi.h, which only introduces the ABI enum and declares these helpers, this .cc file contains the actual mapping tables implemented as conditionals and a switch.
